question: As of 2021, Which is the only country in the world that has both tigers and lions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** India** is the only country in the world that has both **tigers and lions**.
 
• India is home to several well-known large animals.
 
• It includes the Indian elephant, Indian rhinoceros, Bengal tiger, Asiatic lion, Indian leopard, snow leopard, and clouded leopard.
 
• However, that is not the case for all other countries in the world.
 
• In some countries, only a few of the big cats are found.
 
• However, only in India both Tigers and Lions are found.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Elephants and lions are also found in South Africa.
 
• Lions and Rhinos are also found in South Africa.
 
• Tigers and Elephants are also found in other south-east Asian countries.
